Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing residence restrictions for sex offenders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing residence restrictions for sexoffenders; creating a new section; repealing 2005 c 436 s 4(uncodified); and repealing 2005 c 436 s 6 (uncodified).
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Sections 1 through 3 and 5 of chapter 436,Laws of 2005, supersede and preempt all rules, regulations, codes,statutes, or ordinances of all cities, counties, municipalities, andlocal agencies regarding the same subject matter.
The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: 2005 c 436 s 4 (uncodified); and 2005 c 436 s 6 (uncodified).
